name: Roperite
description: A fearsome critter from American lumberjack tall tales, the Roperite is a pony-sized animal of the California Sierra foothills described as catching prey with a long, prehensile, rope-like beak that it uses as a lasso.

aliases.name: Lariat Snake
aliases.meaning: informal name in some retellings of Cox's account

origin: Restricted in folklore to the foothills of the Sierra Nevada in California, particularly the Digger pine belt of the western slope.
